title: Why Do We Root for Other Players? | Designing Games Worth Watching

scenes.title: Targeted replacement 02
lines: Using actual footage from both games, we will examine finding a participant, choosing one to follow in our minds, and reading risk and outcome.

scenes.title: Targeted replacement 05
lines: Now watch the window-cleaning platforms. Choose red or yellow. Standing on the platform and hanging below it lead to different immediate actions.

scenes.title: Targeted replacement 07
lines: Switch to early Ultimate Chicken Horse gameplay. Watch the moving saw and the chicken character jumping. The danger lies between takeoff and the next platform.
The horse moves in a different attempt. The cut should not make its outcome look like a continuation of the chicken character’s earlier action.
